lenders: BBVA México — publicly offers Crédito Puente en Pesos; up to 65% of project commercial value; benchmark + financial margin.
Banorte — publicly offers Proyectos Inmobiliarios / bridge financing; page states financing up to 80% of total project value; not identified as LTC.

Sociedad Hipotecaria Federal (SHF) — Crédito Puente line offered to financial entities, with developer loans intermediated; up to 65% project value, up to 48 months; 28-day compounded TIIE funding plus surcharge.
Banco Inmobiliario Mexicano (BIM) — publicly offers syndicated bridge loans, up to 65% project value, up to 20% advance, up to 42 months.
Santander — no public developer bridge-loan product terms located in reviewed searches; public-facing pages found were housing-buyer products.
caveats: Published central-bank observations: TIIE de fondeo 6.52% and target 6.50% as of 23 Oct 2026; 28-day TIIE 6.7760% on 23 Oct 2026. The requested October 24 date falls on a non-business day and the table shows no observation that day.

No public, project-specific lender offer exists in these sources. Spread, origination fee and presale threshold are not established by the reviewed official pages; these require lender underwriting and a direct quote.
Polanco V Sección is a premium residential context, but the public terms found are general housing-development products and may not apply to this specific luxury project or borrower.
SHF’s 65% is a maximum against project value, not a published loan-to-cost ratio.
